purpose: Inspect remaining drink/pick-up false triggers in manypeople saved clips under one-frame object support
scope: All native integer video frames within each current candidate action window, not just five sampled frames
positive_rule: One compatible object in selected person's 30% expanded native ROI suffices; same frozen class mapping and ambiguity exclusion
negative_rule: Keep prior frozen five-sample conservative contradiction veto so this experiment changes only positive evidence coverage
cache: Keep existing five observations exactly; infer missing frames with unchanged extraction, shared current RTMO and Retinexformer
person_binding: Nearest event same track_id and history_generation within .55 s; pose one-to-one; actor IoU>.4 abstains. Bounded offline approximation, not freshly tracked full video.
review: Inspect retained cases, preserve uncertain labels. Assistant visual verification, not independent human expert ground truth. No training or model selection on feedback.
